# Good Skill

A reference fixture that satisfies the whole rubric, used to pin the top of the
score range in the validator's test suite.

## When to use

Use when you need an example of a well-formed SKILL.md, or when testing the
validator against a known-good input.

## Workflow

1. Read the frontmatter and confirm name and description are present.
2. Run the rubric.
3. Confirm the score is 100 with zero warnings.

## Notes

This file exists only as a test fixture and is not meant to be activated.
